logger.doc:name: Log Start INFO
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "logType": "INFO", "flowName": "inventory-papi-main-flow", "step": "START", "dateTime": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS"}, "correlationId": vars.correlationId default uuid(), "message": "Inventory Processing started" }]

logger.doc:name: Log Start DEBUG
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "logType": "DEBUG", "flowName": "inventory-papi-main-flow", "step": "START", "dateTime": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS"}, "correlationId": vars.correlationId default uuid(), "message": "Inventory Processing started", "payload": vars.orgFileName default "No file present to process" }]

logger.doc:name: Log no files present
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "logType": "INFO", "dateTime": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS"}, "correlationId": vars.correlationId default uuid(), "message": "No files present to process" }]

logger.doc:name: Log End INFO
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "logType": "INFO", "flowName": "inventory-papi-main-flow", "step": "END", "dateTime": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS"}, "correlationId": vars.correlationId default uuid(), "message": "Inventory Processing ended" }]
